title: Non-anchor position period follow-up prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares absolute-position residue classes before any new scoring pass. It does not add candidate words, reuse public known-plaintext anchor fragments as discovery evidence, or tune against the public anchor-derived additive fragments that have already been rejected.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the predeclared period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared structural period rule over one-based K4 absolute positions
Registered period set chosen before evaluating future observations
No candidate-word material, key offsets, route permutations, or observed fragment scores
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation files created only after source review and before scoring
Independent target positions outside the public known-plaintext anchor fragments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across registered period classes
promotion blocked unless held-out or future independent observations beat null controls
